 Bournemouth v Milan: UEFA Europa League live TV, kick-off and line-ups 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article A first-ever meeting surrounded by huge anticipation takes center stage in European football this Thursday afternoon (22). Kicking off at 4 p.m. (Brasília time), the charming Vitality Stadium in Bournemouth, Dorset, England, will host Bournemouth vs Milan on matchday three of the 2026 UEFA Europa League.
 Read also: Flamengo vs Estudiantes: what to expect from the decisive Libertadores semifinal clash
 This will be the first time the two teams have met in a competitive match, adding an extra layer of international rivalry and tactical intrigue between English and Italian football.
 OneFootball Videos
 Both clubs head into the fixture buoyed by strong recent results in their domestic leagues and eager to take a significant step toward qualifying from the group stage of the continental competition.
 Where to watch Bournemouth vs Milan live?
 For fans and European football enthusiasts who want to follow every moment of this historic encounter, official coverage in Brazil will be available exclusively through the digital platform:
 Bournemouth head into the match with a perfect home record in Europe
 AFC Bournemouth are enjoying a spell of great confidence this season. The English side have won their last two matches, beating Sunderland 2–0 in the Premier League and Sturm Graz 3–0 in the Europa League , showing solidity and resilience after recent defeats to Chelsea and Liverpool . In the continental competition, the Cherries have a flawless record: two wins from two matches, six points, five goals scored and just one conceded.
 Playing in front of their own fans at the Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth will rely on their midfield intensity and the impressive form of young forward Rayan , their standout attacking player in the European tournament with two goals. The English side's manager will be without injured midfielder Alex Scott but trusts his squad depth to retain top spot and remain unbeaten.
 Official Bournemouth lineup
 Photo: Courtesy / Instagram @afcb
 Confirmed absentee: Alex Scott (injured). 
 Milan seek consistency away from home in the competition.
 On the other side of the pitch, AC Milan arrive in England in good form in Serie A , following an impressive, action-packed 3–2 victory over Atalanta . In the Europa League , however, the Rossoneri giants are seeking greater consistency: they have three points after two matches, with an emphatic win over Red Bull Salzburg (4–0) and a defeat to Benfica (2–0). With four goals scored and two conceded in the tournament, Milan are looking to pick up points away from home to establish themselves in the automatic qualification places.
 The Italian side will rely on the experience of internationally renowned stars such as midfielder Luka Modrić , Christian Pulisic and Adrien Rabiot , as well as the goalscoring instincts of A. Cissè (the team's leading scorer in the competition with three goals) and Gonçalo Ramos up front. On the injury front, Milan's manager must cope with the confirmed absence of midfielder Alexis Saelemaekers, while forward Samuel Chukwueze remains a doubt.
 Official AC Milan lineup
 Photo: Courtesy / Instagram @acmilan
 Confirmed absentee: Alexis Saelemaekers (injured). 
 Greek and Dutch officiating team
 UEFA has appointed a four-person officiating team from Greece to oversee proceedings at the Vitality Stadium, with VAR support from the Netherlands:
 Referee: Vassilis Fotias (Greece) 
 Assistant referee 1: Andreas Meintanas (Greece) 
 Assistant referee 2: Michail Papadakis (Greece) 
 Video Assistant Referee (VAR): Dennis Higler (Netherlands) 
 Match details: Bournemouth vs Milan
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ): Bournemouth vs Milan
 What time is the Europa League match between Bournemouth and Milan?
 The third group-stage match will be played this Thursday, October 22, 2026, with kickoff scheduled for 4 p.m. (Brasília time).
 Where can you watch Bournemouth vs Milan live?
 The first-ever meeting at the Vitality Stadium will be broadcast live and exclusively in Brazil on the official Cazé TV YouTube channel.
 How are the teams shaping up for this European fixture?
 Bournemouth have a perfect record in the Europa League , with six points, and are coming off a win over Sunderland . AC Milan have three points, beat Atalanta at the weekend in Italy's Serie A and are looking to prove themselves on the European stage away from home.
